newsitem.title: USA: Helionetics engages McAtee as banker.
newsitem.headline: Helionetics engages McAtee as banker.

text.p: Helionetics Inc said engaged McAtee & Co Inc, a Connecticut-based investment advisement firm to serve as its exclusive investment banker.

The agreement pertains to all Helionetics units and controlled companies, including AccuLase Inc., San Diego, a research and development company whose patented laser technology is now in clinical human testing in association with transmyocardial revascularization (TMR) procedures.

He said in addition to capital formation, McAtee & Co will advise the company relating to the sale, combination, joint venture, corporate restructure or similar transactions of the parent or its subsidiary and controlled companies.
